records.title: Attack 1

fields.form:
(⟦H⟧) ATTACK DATA:
⟦U⟧.S.S. FINBACK           TORPEDO ATTACK NO. 1       PATROL NO. 7
⟦T⟧ime 0152 (I) Date 1-2-44 Lat. 29° 30' (⟦N⟧) Long. 128° 50'(⟦E⟧)
TARGET DATA                           DA⟦MA⟧GE INFLICTED
⟦De⟧scription: Target was picked up at 22,000 yards on P.P.I. screen.  He
            was making 14 knots, zig-zagging, and supersonic ranging
            was heard once in his direction.  Target was a large tanker
            of 10,000 tons or more.  He could not be identified more
            closely in the darkness.  Target was picked up during moon-
            light and attacked after moonset under an overcast sky.
            Target had no escort when he was attacked.
⟦Sh⟧ip's ⟦/⟧ Sunk:
⟦Sh⟧ip's Damaged
            None
⟦Pr⟧obably sunk: 1 tanker of about 10,000 tons.  (later sunk)
⟦Da⟧mage Determined
               : seeing two torpedoes hit.
⟦Ta⟧rget Draft: 28             Course 230     Speed 16
OWN SHIP DATA
⟦Sp⟧eed 10     Course 310      Depth  ⟦   ⟧   Angle ⟦     ⟧ Range 3,000
                                                        (at firing)
FIRE CONTROL AND TORPEDO DATA
⟦Ty⟧pe Attack: Surface attack using T.B.T. bearings and Radar ranges.
            Fired first torpedo with constant bearing and others with
            T.D.C. check bearings.  Reason for not using 90° track

fields.form:
U.S.S. FINBACK              GUN ATTACK NO. 1           PATROL NO. 7
⟦T⟧ime 1110 (I) Date 1-30-44 Lat. 30° 19' (⟦N⟧) Long. 134° 00'(⟦E⟧)
TARGET DATA                           DA⟦MAGE INFLICTED⟧
⟦S⟧unk:                               Trawler (sampan bow) of about 100 tons.  Target speeded
Damaged or :                          up from 7 to 10 knots.  Diesel propelled.
⟦Probab⟧ly Sunk
⟦Da⟧mage Determined: Going alongside and examining visually.  Left with
                   : stern submerged, on fire, and sinking.
DETAILS OF ACTION
Sea was condition four which made the ship an unstable platform.
⟦T⟧arget bounced around in sea.  Sighted target with #1 p⟦e⟧riscope and
closed it on the surface.  Opened fire at 2,100 yards with 4" gun using
sensitive nose ammunition.  Gradually closed range to 400 yards.  Open-
ed fire with three 20 mm guns and two air cooled 50 cal. machine guns.
At 1,000 yards target fired at us with small arms until we silenced
them with several hits which cleaned off the superstructure.
Used SJ Radar for ranges.  Fire was not too accurate in this sea.
The loss of our foot firing device, due to the linkage carrying away in
rough seas enroute to the area, undoubtedly caused a lot of near misses.
Sensitive nose ammunition was very effective against this wooden target.
Ammunition Expended:
     4" -  99 rounds
  20 mm - 550 rounds
 50 cal.- 320 rounds

fields.form:
U.S.S. FINBACK              GUN ATTACK NO. 2           PATROL NO. 7
Time 1431 (I)   Date 1-31-44          Lat. 30° 42' (⟦N⟧)      Long. 139° 49' (E)
TARGET DATA                           DAMAGE INFLICTED
Sunk:
Damaged or :                          Trawler of about 100 tons.  Target speed of 7 knots.
Probably Sunk:                        Diesel propelled.  Damaged.
Damage Determined: Seeing 4 inch shells hit and explode.  Superstructure
               by: and hull holed.
DETAILS OF ACTION
Sea was condition four.  Too rough for good shooting.  Sighted
target with #1 periscope and closed it on the surface.  Opened fire
at 2,200 yards with 4" gun using 4" common ammunition.  Closed range
to 900 yards.  Opened fire with three 20 mm guns and two air cooled
50 cal. machine guns at 1,800 yards when target opened fire with a
machine gun.  Obtained about eight hits with 4" gun, three of which
exploded.  Numerous hits were obtained with the small arms and the
enemy machine gun was silenced.  The small arms eliminated all per-
sonnel topside.  Broke off action when all 4" ammunition was expended.
Had we had a smooth sea, more hits would have been obtained, and the
target completely wrecked.  The lack of a foot firing device again
contributed to our inaccuracy of fire.  Sensitive nose ammunition is
much more effective than common ammunition against targets.
Ammunition expended:
     4" - 129 rounds
  20 mm - 600 rounds
 50 cal - 600 rounds
